 Your Role
 As a French speaking .NET Developer , you will design, develop and maintain reliable .NET applications that support our clients' business needs. You will work closely with technical, functional and client-facing teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Develop and maintain high-quality applications and software components using .NET technologies.
Translate business and technical requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions.
Collaborate with development, functional and client teams in both French and English.
Contribute to code reviews, testing, troubleshooting and continuous improvement of applications and development practices.
 Your Profile
Hands-on experience developing applications using .NET and C#.
Good understanding of object-oriented programming, software engineering principles and application development lifecycles.
Ability to analyse requirements, troubleshoot technical issues and contribute effectively within a collaborative development team.
Professional French is mandatory, enabling you to communicate confidently with French-speaking stakeholders.
Good English communication skills for working within an international environment.
